who: Adults with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that has spread or cannot be removed by surgery, with a PIK3CA mutation, whose cancer grew after one CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment.
extentQuote: HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer (ABC) with radiological or objective evidence of recurrence or progression

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA
biomarkers.detail: A known PIK3CA mutation in the cancer
biomarkers.quote: One or more known primary oncogenic PIK3CA mutation(s)

biomarkers.name: HR / HER2
biomarkers.quote: HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer

priorTreatment.detail: Cancer grew after exactly one CDK4/6 inhibitor and 1 to 2 hormone treatments
priorTreatment.quote: Only 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy in one of the following settings:

brainMets.quote: Known active uncontrolled or symptomatic CNS metastases associated with progressive neurological symptoms or requiring ongoing corticosteroids or anticonvulsants for symptomatic control

ecogQuote: Patient has ECOG performance status of 0-1

other.text: No earlier PI3K, AKT or mTOR inhibitors, immunotherapy or antibody-drug conjugates
other.quote: PIK3, AKT, or mTOR inhibitors or any agent whose mechanism of action is the inhibit the PIK3/AKT/mTOR pathway
Type 1 diabetes, or Type 2 diabetes requiring antihyperglycemic medication

other.text: Premenopausal women must take ovarian suppression
other.quote: Pre-menopausal (and peri-menopausal) women can be enrolled if amenable to treatment with a gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonist.
